I built the flyer and rendered all three sizes (portrait, wide, sky), and the layout checks came back with no defects.

- **Layout:** The red bar and the footer stay full width in every size. The three candidates stay evenly spaced, and the photo is cropped to fit its band rather than stretched.
- **Wide:** The photo band gets shorter here, so most of the photo is cut off. I aimed the crop a little below center to keep the house and hills in view.
- **Sky:** Everything is shrunk to 0.28, so the text is very small: the footer is about 6px, and the steps and candidate names are only a little bigger. The footer will probably be hard to read at that size. Making it bigger would mean using larger text across all sizes, since the text can't be sized separately per format.
